title: aether_converter plan output
description: The single JSON document `aether_converter plan --south S --north N --west W --east E --resolutions 30,90` prints on stdout. Authoritative source: crates/aether_converter/src/plan.rs. The geometry reproduces the Python authority (waveshed/core/terrain_adapter.py) exactly; consumers cross-check their own tile enumeration (count and filenames) against this document and abort on mismatch.

tile_count.description: Number of entries in tiles[]. Requests above 2,000,000 tiles fail with a 'bbox too large' error instead of producing a document.

resolution_m.description: The integer resolution the caller requested (also printed in the filename).

filename.description: tile_N{lat:.2}E{lon:.2}_{res}m.abt — lat/lon are the tile's north/west edges.

ul_lat.description: Tile north edge (WGS84), rounded to 6 decimals.

ul_lon.description: Tile west edge (east-positive), rounded to 6 decimals.

size_px.description: Tile side in pixels; rounded up to a multiple of 4 (BC6H block alignment).

exact_res_m.description: The resolution the tile actually delivers: sub_extent_deg / size_px * 111111.

tiles.description: Ordered: resolutions ascending, then latitude ascending, then longitude ascending.
